inputs_consulted_for_design: paper (ICML 2023) Sec. 6, App. E, App. H.2
aggregate task and group frequencies of the defense_fit role (no features, no fit) for the HMDA gamma ceiling
features: rep_p0 (64-d float64 frozen representation of the income_prediction / underwriting purpose); all continuous, cat_pos = []

hmda.note: official fit supports >2 groups only with the documented buffer-size fix (FARE_ENV_RECIPE.md); groups are recoded to 0..G-1 inside fit; no binarisation

fit_rows: all defense_fit rows (the certificate uses separate rows the tree never saw)
seed_mapping: fit seed = seed_base + encoder seed k (k in {0,1,2}); DecisionTreeClassifier random_state = 43 + seed (official src/tree/main.py:33 hard-codes 43, so seed 0 == official). random_state only orders candidate features, i.e. breaks exact ties.

grid.name: F1_task_first_k100_g0.3
grid.source: official code/shell/ACSIncome-CA-2014/run_tree.sh sweep 1 (k in {2..200}, ni=100, alpha in {0.1..0.999}); paper App. H.2 'Accurate' gamma=0.3
grid.rationale: largest cell budget with a weak fairness weight; n_i raised from H.2's 10 to the official sweep's 100 so every cell keeps certificate mass

grid.name: F2_task_first_k50_g0.7
grid.source: official run_tree.sh sweep 1; k=50/ni=100 is the shipped reproduction-gate configuration (there with alpha=0.9)

grid.name: F3_balanced_k20_g0.85
grid.source: paper App. H.2 'Balanced' (gamma=0.85, ni=100, v=0.3), k=20 from the H.2 k grid {3,5,8,20,50}

grid.name: F4_protect_k10_g0.9_ni1000
grid.source: official run_tree.sh sweep 2 (k in {2..10}, ni=1000, alpha in {0.8..0.999}, v=0.5)
grid.rationale: small budget, large cells (tight per-cell Clopper-Pearson bounds), strong fairness weight

grid.name: F5_protect_k5_g0.95_ni1000
grid.source: official run_tree.sh sweep 2; k=5 from paper App. H.2
grid.rationale: stronger fairness weight and fewer cells

grid.name: F6_protect_k3_g0.95_ni1000
grid.source: paper App. H.2 'Fair' (gamma=0.999, ni=1000, v=0.5) at k=3; gamma capped at 0.95 (see hmda_gamma_ceiling)
grid.rationale: most protective non-degenerate point shared by both encoders

zero_fairness_control.definition: oar.fare_official.zero_fairness(grid[nominee]): same max_leaf_nodes, min_samples_leaf and criterion, gamma = 0.0
zero_fairness_control.official_path: fair_gini_dp with alpha=0 gives impurity = 1*Gini_y + 0*(0.5-Gini_s) = Gini_y exactly; verified identical to criterion='gini' (oar/tests test_b2)
zero_fairness_control.registered_control: the twin of the validation-selected nominee (fitting all six twins is cheap but descriptive only)

hmda_gamma_ceiling.why: the official criterion uses the binary constant 0.5: FairGini = (1-g) Gini_y + g (0.5 - Gini_s). With 5 race groups Gini_s can exceed 0.5; on defense_fit Gini_s = 0.50868 and Gini_y = 0.19119, so the root FairGini is <= 0 for g >= Gini_y / (Gini_y + Gini_s - 0.5) = 0.9566, and the official builder turns any node with impurity <= EPSILON into a leaf (sktree/_tree.pyx _add_split_node). g >= 0.957 would therefore give a 1-cell (constant) HMDA encoder by construction.
hmda_gamma_ceiling.adult: binary sex: Gini_s <= 0.5 always, no ceiling
hmda_gamma_ceiling.consequence: the paper's 'Fair' gamma=0.999 is replaced by 0.95 in F5/F6 so the grid is identical for both encoders

not_varied.val_split_v: replaced by the study's separate certificate rows; the tree is fit on all defense_fit rows
not_varied.gini_metric: dp only (eo/eopp criteria exist upstream but are not the study's criterion)

certificate_notes.meaning: groups=None -> every group present in the fit rows: Adult 1 pair; HMDA 5 groups -> 10 pairs, delta/10 per pair (paper App. D.1), bound = max over pairs. Per pair eps_b = eps_s = 10%, eps_c = 80% of the pair budget (paper App. E: 0.005/0.04/0.005 of 0.05). Lemma 5.1 on the fit rows' aggregate group counts (official), Lemma 5.2 on D_val, Lemma 5.3 on D_test, a seeded 50/50 split of the cert rows.
certificate_notes.rows: must be disjoint from (and independent of) the fit rows; refused on exact duplicates; split by unit/person
certificate_notes.unavailable_when: any pair has a cell absent from its base, D_val or D_test rows (official assertion) or a non-finite bound; reported, never patched

optional_secondary.note: 3 pairs; declare before the run if wanted. Not a substitute for the full-declared result.

certificate_notes.usage: pass the 'certificate' dict as-is: oar.fare_official.certificate(model, X_cert, s_cert, prop['certificate'])

calibration.structural_note: HMDA realises fewer cells than k-bar under the fairness weight (F2 22, F4 4, F5 2, F6 2 at seed 0); F5 and F6 give the identical HMDA tree
